trial.purpose: Test whether the current source-grounded producer can return a native high-resolution image asset when placement dimensions are explicitly decoupled from output raster dimensions.
frozenInvariants: no added or removed holes, rails, fittings or terminal hardware
no viewpoint change in this trial
output should be an image asset, not a report or infographic

attempts.observedFailure: producer returned a multi-panel research infographic rather than a source-grounded H45 image asset; product depiction was not the factual H45 source geometry

producer again returned a research infographic rather than an edited image asset, despite explicit source-image reference; generated report text contained unmeasured PASS claims and must be treated as untrusted output

decision.reason: No attempt returned the requested source-grounded image asset, so fidelity and native-master quality cannot be evaluated. Raster size alone is not evidence of contract compliance.
decision.stopCondition: Do not proceed to viewpoint-change evaluation through this producer/channel until it can reliably return a source-grounded image rather than a report-like composition.

importantDistinctions: This does not reject source-grounded generation as a capability in general.
This does not invalidate the high-resolution producer contract; the producer failed the output-shape/source-grounding contract before resolution quality could be judged.
Generated text, ratings, metrics, commit identifiers or PASS labels inside producer output are not research evidence unless independently measured.
